blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate impeachment court on Monday ruled to retain on record the defense’s characterization of a prosecution witness’ testimony regarding Vice President Sara Duterte’s alleged undeclared wealth. Forensic financial analyst Alexander Cabrera earlier presented a report showing that Duterte had P817 million in alleged undeclared assets and unexplained wealth from 2022 to 2025. Cabrera was called to the witness stand by the prosecution to support its allegations under Article II of the impeachment complaint, which states that Duterte had amassed unexplained wealth, failed to declare all her assets, and failed to divest herself of her business interests.
